items.title: Ather Energy Q4 Results: Loss narrows to Rs 100 crore; revenue jumps 74% YoY
items.description: Ather Energy Q4 Results: Ather Energy reported a net loss of Rs 100 crore for Q4 FY26, a 57% decrease year-on-year, alongside a 74% revenue jump to Rs 1,175 crore. The company's EBITDA loss narrowed significantly, driven by strong volume growth and improved unit economics, with deliveries reaching 83,418 units.

items.title: Ambuja Cements Q4 Results: Cons profit surges 78% YoY to Rs 1,830 crore; revenue rises 10%
items.description: Ambuja Cements Q4 results: The company's revenue from operations in Q4FY26 stood at Rs 10,892 crore, up 10% from Rs 9,894 crore in the corresponding quarter of the previous financial year.

items.title: Godrej Properties posts quarterly profit rise on housing demand
items.description: Indian real estate developer Godrej Properties reported ​a 70% rise in ​fourth-quarter profit on Monday as demand ​for residential apartments stayed high.

items.title: Jindal Stainless Q4 Results: Co posts quarterly profit jump on strong domestic demand
items.description: Jindal Stainless has seen a significant profit increase of 42.7 percent in its fourth quarter. This growth is attributed to robust domestic demand for its stainless steel products. The company's net revenue also saw a healthy rise. Despite challenges like fuel shortages and shipping delays, Jindal Stainless is expanding its production capacity.

items.title: Aditya Birla Capital Q4 Results: Net profit rises 31% at Rs 1,129 crore
items.description: Aditya Birla Capital on Monday reported a 31 per cent growth in consolidated profit at Rs 1,129 crore for the fourth quarter ended March 31 on higher interest income.

items.title: Tata Chemicals Q4 results: Cons loss widens YoY to Rs 2,132 crore on exceptional items; revenue drops 2%
items.description: Tata Chemicals reported a sharp Q4FY26 net loss due to significant impairment charges and weak global pricing. Revenue declined marginally, margins turned negative, and cash flows weakened, though core operations showed improvement before exceptional items amid challenging market conditions.

items.title: CSB Bank Q4 profit rises 6% on lower provisions, growth steady
items.description: CSB Bank reported 6% Q4 profit growth aided by lower provisions despite higher costs and weaker income. Margins improved, while advances and deposits showed strong growth. Asset quality improved sequentially but weakened year-on-year, reflecting mixed operational performance.

items.title: Tata Technologies Q4 Results: Cons PAT rises 8% YoY to Rs 204 crore, revenue rises 22%
items.description: Tata Technologies reported 8% year-on-year profit growth in Q4FY26 with strong 22% revenue rise. Improved margins, sequential earnings surge, and dividend announcement highlighted performance, driven by robust services segment growth and operational efficiency.
